remarks: An excellent opportunity to live in this spacious 5 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms Colonial located on a private road in the Brookside section of Norwalk. The home was recently remodeled; and has all new windows, a new kitchen, new appliances, and new bathrooms. The property has a living room and dining room, with gleaming hardwood floors throughout. On the main level, there is a family room/office/library with built-in bookshelves, a work desk, and a fireplace. The primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet, a full bathroom, and a private balcony. There is a two-car garage and plenty of yard space. Perfect for commuters, with easy access to I-95 and minutes to the Rowayton Metro North Station. It is conveniently located close to Rowayton, Darien, and many Norwalk amenities.
